messages.author: 93874b893a739d94
messages.subject: ploting two data frame in one plot
parts:
Hi group members
I was using the ggplot2 0.8.9
and used to plot the two data frame in one plot using the commnds below and it was doing good.
But once I installed the ggplo2 0.9.0 the same example gives me the following error 
Error in initFields(scales = scales) : could not find function "initRefFields"
and error messagefor the geom_line is "invalid argument to unary operator"
I tried the help(initRefFields) but the message was "No documentation for ‘initRefFields’ in specified packages and libraries:
you could try ‘??initRefFields’
library(ggplot2)
 data1 <- data.frame(tt=runif(31), zz=runif(31))
 data2 <- data.frame(tt=runif(31), yy=runif(31))
 qplot(tt,zz,data=data1, col="blue", lty=1,main="The time series graph of TCs and TSs", geom="line")
 + geom_line(data=data2,aes(tt,yy),color="blue")
 
Could any one help this
 
rgdskaikombo

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: ploting two data frame in one plot
parts:
When I ran your example it gave me a different error... 
Error: A continuous variable can not be mapped to linetype

I typed it out using ggplot instead of qplot (as is best when you have a plot with any amount of tweaking), and I got no error. 

ggplot()+geom_line(data=data1, aes(x=tt, y=zz), colour="blue", linetype=2)+geom_line(data=data2,aes(tt,yy),color="blue")

B
